tags.definition: Visible exposed liquid. Blue-green rock and solid archival bands are insufficient.
Clearly exposed metal structure, machinery or fixtures materially contributing to the scene.
Visible vegetation; biological tissue alone is insufficient.
Visibly layered rock or sediment, or layered engineered material clearly composing the cutaway.
Familiar-world objects and physically plausible construction or terrain. Pixel rendering does not affect this call.
Prominent visible supporting or spanning roots.
Recognizable electronic terminal or monitor workstation. Generic cabinets, tablets and film racks are insufficient.
Cloth canopies, curtains or swatches with fabric character. Technological foil can use membrane alone.
Prominent cellular/perforated form; record the substance separately when supported.
Visible land/water interface; blue haze alone is insufficient.
Visible technical systems presented as beyond ordinary real-world infrastructure.
Prominent thin sheet, veined collecting surface or sac wall. Biological and technological interpretations need their own evidence.
Waterlogged ground, shallow pools or marsh vegetation organizing part of the scene.
Organic-looking branching, cellular or membrane form, without asserting a particular organism.
Source-supported ceramic or convincing fired material. Pale rock alone is insufficient.
Visible vacuum, stars or orbital setting; futuristic interiors alone are insufficient.
Source-supported separation/cleaning of material streams. Pipes alone are insufficient.
A recognizable building or installation adapted to a different use.
Prominent mineral-like deposits or biomineral features without claiming chemistry.
Source-identified archive of records or memory media. Does not imply a visible computer.
Source-supported heat-transfer infrastructure; visible machinery tagged separately.
An open expanse with little relief or cover, whether pristine or marked by structures and activity.
A hopeful built setting visibly integrating ecological design and shared infrastructure.
A recognizable spacecraft visible in the scene, including in a shipyard. The primary category requires the craft to dominate.
An unmistakable fantastical subject or environment, such as magical monumental architecture or supernatural growth.
Source-described low-temperature storage/transfer; visible frost is separately tagged ice.
Supported sea-glass archival layers or glazing. Translucent biological sheets alone are insufficient.
Source-supported storage in biological structures. Substance remains unspecified.
Source-described community activity, potentially useful across categories.
Removal of accumulated sediment from waterways, supported by the source caption.
Visible photographic film strips/reels or processing materials.
Collection of airborne moisture using mesh or related infrastructure.
Dark exterior sky and nighttime lighting in the depicted scene.
Recognizable photographic workflow including film, development trays or photographs.
Source-supported trapping or stabilizing of sediment.
Source-supported control of heat in a glacier or environment.
Source-described heat-storage biological environment; does not establish lava.
Visible/source-supported water-control barrier. Dust-collector fibres are insufficient.
